appName.message: Dual Subtitles — Lingogram: YouTube, Netflix లో భాషలు నేర్చుకోండి
appName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome and the Web Store.

appDesc.message: YouTube, Netflix లో డ్యూయల్ సబ్టైటిల్స్ — రెండు భాషలు ఒకేసారి. చూసేదాని నుంచే ఇంగ్లీష్ నేర్చుకోండి, ఒక్క ట్యాప్‌తో పదాలు సేవ్.

ytOnboardingText.message: ప్రారంభించడానికి మీరు నేర్చుకుంటున్న భాషను మరియు మీ మాతృభాషను ఎంచుకోండి.
ytOnboardingText.description: Onboarding banner body asking the user to pick languages.

ytLearningLabel.description: Label for the "language I am learning" picker.

ytNativeLabel.description: Label for the "my native language" picker.

ytSelectPlaceholder.description: Placeholder option in a language dropdown.

ytSearchingTitle.description: Status banner heading while looking for subtitles.

ytSearchingText.message: ఈ వీడియో కోసం ఉపశీర్షికల కోసం వెతుకుతోంది.
ytSearchingText.description: Status banner body while looking for subtitles.

ytNoSubsTitle.description: Status banner heading when a video has no subtitles.

ytNoSubsText.message: ఈ వీడియోకి ఉపశీర్షికలు లేవు. మరో వీడియోని ప్రయత్నించండి — YouTubeలో ప్రతి వీడియోకి ఉపశీర్షికలు ఉండవు.
ytNoSubsText.description: Status banner body when a video has no subtitles.

ytSearchAgain.description: Retry button label on the no-subtitles banner.

ytReloadPage.description: Fallback button on the no-subtitles banner, shown after a retry still found no subtitles, that reloads the page.

ytNoSubsRetryText.message: ఈ వీడియోలో సబ్‌టైటిల్స్ ఉన్నా మేము వాటిని చూపించకపోతే, పేజీని రీలోడ్ చేయండి — ఇది తరచుగా సహాయపడుతుంది, మరియు పరిశీలించడానికి మాకు ఒక నివేదిక అందుతుంది.
ytNoSubsRetryText.description: Status banner body after a failed retry. Qualifies the emergency reload click ('video HAS subtitles, extension failed') so it doubles as a bug report to the admins, and discloses that a report is sent.

ytSignInToSave.message: పదాలను సేవ్ చేయడానికి సైన్ ఇన్ చేయండి
ytSignInToSave.description: Account prompt to sign in and save vocabulary.

ytSavedBadge.description: Inline badge shown after a word is saved.

ytStyleFontLabel.description: CEA-708 font class name, matches YouTube's own caption settings.

ytFontMonoSerif.description: CEA-708 font class name, matches YouTube's own caption settings.

ytFontPropSerif.description: CEA-708 font class name, matches YouTube's own caption settings.

ytFontMonoSans.description: CEA-708 font class name, matches YouTube's own caption settings.

ytFontPropSans.description: CEA-708 font class name, matches YouTube's own caption settings.

ytFontCasual.description: CEA-708 font class name, matches YouTube's own caption settings.

ytFontCursive.description: CEA-708 font class name, matches YouTube's own caption settings.

ytFontSmallCaps.description: CEA-708 font class name, matches YouTube's own caption settings.

ytStyleSizeLabel.description: Label for the subtitle overlay font-size slider (50-400%).

ytStyleColorLabel.description: Label for the subtitle overlay text-color swatches (main line).

ytStyleSubSizeLabel.description: Label for the translation-line font-size slider (50-400%), independent of the main line.

ytStyleSubColorLabel.description: Label for the translation-line text-color swatches, independent of the main line.

ytStyleTextOpacityLabel.description: Label for the subtitle text glyph-opacity presets (fades the letters, not the box behind them).

ytStyleCustomColor.description: Accessible label and tooltip for the custom-color well at the end of every color swatch row.

ytStyleBgColorLabel.description: Label for the subtitle caption-box background-color swatches.

ytStyleOffsetLabel.description: Label for the subtitle overlay vertical-position presets.

ytStyleBgLabel.description: Label for the subtitle overlay backdrop-opacity presets (how solid the caption box is, distinct from its color).

ytGroupLanguages.description: Settings panel group header for subtitle track language pickers.

ytGroupReadingMode.description: Settings panel group header for reading-mode toggles.

ytModesLabel.description: Tiny uppercase label inside the sidebar quick-mode cluster (Dual/Guess/On-screen buttons). Keep it one short word.

ytGroupText.description: Settings panel group header for subtitle text appearance: font, size, color.

ytGroupBox.description: Settings panel group header for the caption box and where it sits on the video.

ytModeSwap.description: Button that swaps the learning and native subtitle tracks.

ytModeDual.description: Toggle that shows both languages at once.

ytModeGuess.description: Toggle for the word-guessing practice mode.

ytModeOnScreen.description: Toggle that shows subtitles on the video itself.

ytStyleEdgeLabel.description: Label for the subtitle text edge-style presets.

ytEdgeNone.description: Edge style preset: no text shadow or outline.

ytEdgeShadow.description: Edge style preset: drop shadow behind the text.

ytEdgeOutline.description: Edge style preset: dark outline around each letter.

ytStyleReset.description: Button that restores the default overlay appearance.

ytOverlayOffNote.description: Note shown in the style preview when the on-video overlay is disabled.

ytPreviewSampleMain.description: Sample subtitle line shown in the style preview when no video subtitle is loaded.

ytPreviewSampleSub.description: Sample translation line shown in the style preview.

ytSettingsTitle.description: Sidebar header title while the settings panel is open.

ytLangGroupAvailable.description: Dropdown group heading for subtitle languages the current video offers.

ytLangGroupOther.description: Dropdown group heading for languages not available in the current video (shown disabled).

ytRateButton.description: Primary button on the rating prompt; opens the extension's Web Store review page.

ytRateQ.description: Step 1 of the rating prompt: asks whether the user likes the extension before any store link is offered.

ytRateQSub.message: ఇప్పటికే మీరు చాలా పదాలు సేవ్ చేశారు.
ytRateQSub.description: Subtitle under the step-1 question of the rating prompt; reminds the user of the value they got.

ytRateStep2.message: వెబ్ స్టోర్‌లో మీ రేటింగ్ మాకు ఎంతో విలువైనది. అలాగే ఇతరులు మమ్మల్ని కనుగొంటారు.
ytRateStep2.description: Body of step 2 of the rating prompt: a gratitude-framed ask for a Web Store rating, shown only after the user said yes.

ytRateYes.description: Positive answer on step 1 of the rating prompt; leads to the star step.

ytRateNo.description: Negative answer on step 1 of the rating prompt; thanks the user and closes.

ytRateThanks.description: Shown briefly after a negative answer on the rating prompt, then the card closes itself.

ytRateFeedbackTitle.description: Title of the feedback form shown after a negative answer on the rating prompt.

ytRateFeedbackSent.description: Confirmation shown briefly after feedback is sent, then the card closes.

ytRateFeedbackFailed.description: Error shown when sending feedback failed; the user can retry.

ytRateSkip.description: Dismiss button on the feedback form shown after a negative answer.

ytRateSend.description: Submit button on the feedback form.

ytRateSending.description: Submit button label while the feedback is in flight.

ytRateThanksYes.description: Title of step 2 of the rating prompt, acknowledging the user's positive answer.

ytRateLater.description: Dismiss button on the rating prompt.

ytMenuLabel.description: Accessible name of the menu opened from the button in YouTube's player controls.

ytMenuModes.description: Player-menu row that opens the reading-mode submenu; shows the current mode next to it.

ytMenuModeSingle.description: Reading mode: one subtitle line, no translation. Menu wording of the neither-dual-nor-guess state.

ytMenuModeDual.description: Reading mode: original and translation at once. Menu wording of ytModeDual, which is icon-sized.

ytMenuModeGuess.description: Reading mode: some words hidden until clicked. Menu wording of ytModeGuess, which is icon-sized.

ytMenuBack.description: Player-menu control returning from a submenu to the main list.

ytMenuOpenPanel.description: Player-menu row that expands the sidebar.

ytMenuHidePanel.description: Player-menu row that collapses the sidebar; replaces ytMenuOpenPanel while it is open.

ytMenuSettings.description: Player-menu row that opens the sidebar with the settings panel showing.

ytMenuOverlay.description: Player-menu toggle for the on-video subtitle overlay.

ytMenuChooseLanguages.description: Player-menu button shown before any languages are picked; opens the sidebar onboarding.

ytMenuNoSubtitles.description: Player-menu status line when no caption track was found. The line doubles as a retry button.

ytMenuNoTranslation.message: మీ భాషలో ఉపశీర్షికలు లేవు, మూల భాష మాత్రమే
ytMenuNoTranslation.description: Player-menu status line when the video is captioned in the language being learned but not in the user's native language. Informational, not an error: this is a normal outcome and there is nothing to retry.

ytTogglePanel.description: Accessible name of the tab at the screen edge that opens and closes the sidebar.

ytAuthSignInTitle.description: Heading of the sign-in popup opened from the account row above the subtitle list.

ytAuthSignInAction.description: Button that opens the Lingogram website to sign in. 'lingogram' is the product name.

ytAuthSignOut.description: Button that signs the user out of their Lingogram account.

ytAuthSignedIn.description: Fallback account-row text when the user is signed in but the email is unknown.

ytAuthSignedInAs.description: Label above the signed-in user's email address in the account panel.

ytAuthOpenFailed.message: సైన్ ఇన్ పేజీని తెరవలేకపోయాం. మళ్లీ ప్రయత్నించండి.
ytAuthOpenFailed.description: Error shown when the browser could not open the Lingogram sign-in tab.

ytQuickAddPill.description: Button that appears over a selected word to save it. 'Lingogram' is the product name; keep the leading plus sign.

ytQuickAddSaved.description: Confirmation after a word is saved. {term} is the word the user selected and must be kept.

ytQuickAddNeedsSignIn.message: పదాలను సేవ్ చేయడానికి ఉపశీర్షికల జాబితా పైన ఉన్న Lingogram వరుస ద్వారా సైన్ ఇన్ చేయండి.
ytQuickAddNeedsSignIn.description: Error shown when a word cannot be saved because the user is signed out.

ytQuickAddFailed.description: Error shown when saving a word failed. {error} is a technical message and must be kept.

ytPopupLoading.description: Placeholder while the toolbar popup fetches the account status.

ytPopupUnknownEmail.description: Shown in the popup when the signed-in account has no email address on record.

ytPopupSelect.description: Placeholder option in the language dropdowns before a language is chosen.

ytPopupLearning.description: Label for the dropdown where the user picks the language they are learning.

ytPopupNative.description: Label for the dropdown where the user picks their own native language.

ytGuessRevealAria.description: Accessible label for the guess-mode subtitle line, which acts as a button.

ytModeSingle.description: Reading mode that shows only the original-language subtitles. Sits beside ytModeDual and ytModeGuess; keep it one short word.

ytThrottledTitle.description: Status banner heading when YouTube rate-limits (HTTP 429) the subtitle request. Distinct from the no-subtitles banner: the video HAS subtitles, YouTube just refused to serve them right now.

ytThrottledText.message: ఈ వీడియో కోసం సబ్‌టైటిల్ అభ్యర్థనను YouTube తాత్కాలికంగా నిరోధించింది. ఇది వారి వైపు ఉన్న పరిమితి, సబ్‌టైటిల్ లేకపోవడం కాదు — ఇది నిమిషాల్లో తీరవచ్చు, కానీ కొన్నిసార్లు గంటల పాటు ఉంటుంది.
ytThrottledText.description: Status banner body for the rate-limited case. Must not imply the video lacks subtitles, and must not promise a recovery time — the limit has been observed to last hours.

ytRetryInSeconds.description: Disabled retry button label while the rate-limit cooldown runs. {s} is replaced in code with the remaining whole seconds.

ytLoadFailedTitle.description: Status banner heading when the signed subtitle URL expired or no token could be minted — recoverable by searching again.

ytLoadFailedText.message: సబ్‌టైటిల్ లింక్ గడువు ముగిసింది. మళ్లీ వెతకడం సాధారణంగా దీన్ని పరిష్కరిస్తుంది.
ytLoadFailedText.description: Status banner body for the expired-link case.

ytMenuThrottled.message: YouTube అనువాదాన్ని పరిమితం చేసింది — మళ్లీ ప్రయత్నించడానికి నొక్కండి
ytMenuThrottled.description: Quiet player-menu status line when the translated track was rate-limited and a retry is available. The other track is playing normally, so this must not read as a failure of the whole extension.

ytMenuThrottledWait.message: YouTube అనువాదాన్ని పరిమితం చేసింది — {s} సెకన్లలో మళ్లీ ప్రయత్నం
ytMenuThrottledWait.description: Quiet player-menu status line while the rate-limit cooldown runs. {s} is replaced in code with the remaining whole seconds.

ytPartialThrottled.description: Quiet one-line notice under the language chip when the translated track was rate-limited but another track is playing. Keep it short — it sits on one line beside a retry button.

ytPartialNotOffered.description: Quiet notice when YouTube simply has no machine translation for the chosen language. A normal outcome, not an error — nothing to retry.

ytPartialFailed.description: Quiet notice when the translated track failed to load for a recoverable reason other than rate limiting.

ytPartialThrottledHint.message: YouTube మీ కోసం స్వయంచాలక అనువాదాన్ని తాత్కాలికంగా పరిమితం చేసింది. ఇది వారి పరిమితి, పొడిగింపు సమస్య కాదు — ఇది నిమిషాల్లో తీరవచ్చు, కానీ కొన్నిసార్లు గంటల పాటు ఉంటుంది. ఈలోగా అసలైన సబ్‌టైటిల్స్ పనిచేస్తూనే ఉంటాయి.
ytPartialThrottledHint.description: Hover explanation on the partial-failure row when YouTube rate-limited the translation. Honest about duration: minutes to hours, no promises. Reassures that the extension is not broken.

ytPartialNotOfferedHint.message: ఈ వీడియో కోసం ఈ భాషలోకి స్వయంచాలక అనువాదాన్ని YouTube అందించడం లేదు. మళ్లీ ప్రయత్నించడం వల్ల ప్రయోజనం ఉండదు — అసలైన సబ్‌టైటిల్స్ ఇప్పటికీ చూపబడుతున్నాయి.
ytPartialNotOfferedHint.description: Hover explanation when YouTube has no machine translation for the chosen language. Says plainly that retrying is pointless, so the user stops trying.

ytPartialFailedHint.message: అనువాదం లోడ్ కావడానికి ముందే సబ్‌టైటిల్ లింక్ గడువు ముగిసింది. మళ్లీ వెతకడం సాధారణంగా దీన్ని పరిష్కరిస్తుంది.
ytPartialFailedHint.description: Hover explanation when the translated track failed for a recoverable reason other than rate limiting.

ytFeedbackLink.description: Entry point at the bottom of the settings panel that opens the feedback screen.

ytFeedbackTitle.description: Sidebar header title while the feedback screen is open, replacing ytSettingsTitle.

ytFeedbackIntro.message: ఏమి పాడైందో లేదా మీరు ఏమి మారుస్తారో చెప్పండి. మేము అన్నీ చదువుతాము.
ytFeedbackIntro.description: One line of reassurance shown above the feedback message box.

ytFeedbackEmailLabel.description: Label above the optional email field on the feedback screen.

ytFeedbackEmailHint.description: Placeholder inside the optional email field, clarifying it's only needed for a reply.

ytFeedbackBackToSettings.description: Back chip on the feedback screen that returns to settings.

ytFeedbackCharsLeft.description: Byte-budget counter on the feedback form, shown only near the limit. {n} is replaced in code with the number remaining. It is aria-live, so the unit must be in the string — a bare number announces as meaningless.

ytGroupPrivacy.description: Settings panel group header for the anonymous-usage-analytics opt-out toggle.

ytPrivacyAnalyticsLabel.description: Label for the checkbox that turns anonymous product analytics on or off. On by default.

ytPrivacyAnalyticsHint.message: “ఉపశీర్షికలు లోడ్ అయ్యాయి”, “పదం సేవ్ అయింది” వంటి లెక్కలు మాత్రమే. మీ ఖాతా, మీరు చూసే వీడియోలు లేదా మీరు సేవ్ చేసే పదాలు ఎప్పటికీ కాదు.
ytPrivacyAnalyticsHint.description: Explanatory text under the analytics checkbox, stating exactly what is and is not collected. Keep the two quoted event names natural in the target language.
